reviews.text: If the pregnant woman were a little kinder, the place would be perfect. If you find it hard to be patient with dogs, no one forces you.
Professionalism and expertise are the hallmarks of Zaffiro Animali. Highly recommended.

Good morning, I just called this groomer. I asked to have my medium-sized poodle trimmed to 1 cm, and they refused to book me an appointment, claiming they didn't like this type of grooming and that it wasn't professional.
I wonder, if the dog is mine, shouldn't I choose how I want him? Besides, I want him this way because, since he's a (happy) dog who goes to the park, it's easier to keep him groomed... I was speechless.

In response to what you wrote, I absolutely don't believe you're the only ones who groom poodles well. Luckily, we're in Rome, and I've already found other super professionals who will do it. Not a clean shave like you say (which I absolutely didn't ask for), but short and trimmed like I asked (it's my dog, and I decide).
And I'd like to point out that it's one thing for me to ask you to groom a short dog (not a clean shave!!!!, but short and trimmed), and it's another thing for you to ask a doctor to operate as you say (sorry, but the comparison you made is ridiculous).
That said, good work.
I regularly take my poodle to Marco and Valentina. The results are always top-notch; they're unrivaled in Rome. The waiting list is a bit long, but it's definitely worth it. Highly recommended 🔝🔝🔝 …

I have two Huskies and they are truly attentive, precise, and meticulous! They wash and dry the animals thoroughly, and they make the experience as pleasant as possible for the animal! I recommend them to everyone!
We took Cocco for the first time today. We had a great time and are grateful for the attention and care shown, especially considering the age of our beloved pup. We will definitely be back.

Terrible experience......despite the grooming my dog ​​still smelled...........he was very stressed........considering that he is an 11 year old dog and needs special attention........I strongly advise against it.
Excellent service and always available and highly professional staff

Great experience.
